description: Read the training data for an Extract Wrangle
guidance:
### Read #### Recipe ```yaml read: - train.extract: model_id: xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx ``` ##### Output
| Entity to Find | Variation (Optional) | Notes | | :------------- | :------------------- | :---- | | Ball Bearing | bearing, ball | | | Needle Bearing | needle, bearing | | | Roller Bearing | roller, bearing | |
#### Function ```python from wrangles.connectors import train df = train.extract.read(model_id = 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx') ``` ##### Output
| Entity to Find | Variation (Optional) | Notes | | :------------- | :------------------- | :---- | | Ball Bearing | bearing, ball | | | Needle Bearing | needle, bearing | | | Roller Bearing | roller, bearing | |
### Write #### Recipe Update the training data for an existing extract wrangle. ```yaml write: - train.extract: columns: - Entity to Find - Variation (Optional) - Notes model_id: xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx ``` #### Function Create a new classify wrangle. ```python from wrangles.connectors import train import pandas as pd df = pd.DataFrame({ 'Entity to Find': ['Ball Bearing', 'Needle Bearing', 'Roller Bearing'], 'Variation': ['bearing, ball', 'needle, bearing', 'roller, bearing'], 'Notes': ['', '', '', ''] }) train.extract.write(df = df, name = 'Bearing Types') ``` > Note both name and model_id **cannot** be used together. Name is used when creating models and model_id is used when updating an existing model.
